office: the Department of National ID and Civil Registration

routes.label: form filled online, details and biometrics registered at a District or Area Administration Office station or a ward campaign; the card collected where registered after an SMS

cards.for: 16 and over, holding a citizenship certificate

note: The Department's questions and answers: a person of 16 or over holding a Nepali citizenship certificate can get the card, registering details and biometrics at a District Administration Office, an Area Administration Office with a station, or a ward campaign, and collecting the card where registered once an SMS says it is printed. Its citizen charter: registering is free and done the same day when the documents are complete (the time to the printed card isn't given). A copy of the card is charged under the National Identity Card and Registration Regulations 2077 (not modelled). The card's term isn't stated in what was read.

sources.title: Department of National ID and Civil Registration (Nepal), Frequently asked questions: national identity card
sources.said: १६ वर्ष उमेर पुरा भई नेपाली नागरिकताको प्रमाणपत्र लिएका व्यक्तिले राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र प्राप्त गर्न सक्छन् । ... नेपाली नागरिकता प्राप्त व्यक्तिले जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय वा राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र विवरण दर्ता स्टेसन रहेका ईलाका ... SMS अएपछि परिचयपत्रका लागि विवरण जहाँ दर्ता गराएको हो सोहि स्थानबाट ... कार्ड लिनुपर्छ।
